title: LastOperation
description: Details about the last operation performed on the service instance.

type.description: The type of operation that was performed.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

description.description: A human-readable description of the operation status.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the operation was initiated.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the operation status was last updated.
